result.summary: Found 3 issues, including a missing image placeholder in the 'Popular right now' section and a cut-off card in the horizontal scroll list.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a broken/missing image placeholder icon instead of an actual restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the image asset loads correctly or provide a fallback image so the placeholder icon is never shown to users.

issues.description: The third card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' row is cut off at the edge of the screen, truncating the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Adjust card width or add partial peek indication so truncated content is clearly intentional, or increase spacing to avoid abrupt text cutoff.

issues.description: The category filter row (All, Pizza, Sushi, Burgers, Healthy) is cut off on the right edge, hiding additional category options without a clear scroll indicator.
issues.suggestion: Add a fade/gradient edge or scroll arrow to indicate the row is horizontally scrollable.
